commitMessage: Initial governed-banking landing page for Nora

landingPage.headline: Banking AI that can act.
landingPage.subheadline: Nora prepares and verifies complex banking work so teams can move faster — without giving up control, evidence, or accountability.

demoConversation.text: I've prepared the customer file and checked the required evidence.
One item — address proof needs your confirmation before I can move forward.

heroChat.inputPlaceholder: Ask Nora about a banking workflow…

features.title: Customer onboarding
features.body: Prepare KYC files, identify missing evidence, and route exceptions to the right owner.

features.title: Credit & lending
features.body: Assemble credit packs, test policies, and keep decisions ready for review.

features.title: Financial crime
features.body: Investigate alerts with the evidence, rationale, and controls in one place.

features.title: Operations control
features.body: Reconcile breaks, coordinate close tasks, and make every handoff traceable.

features.title: Service & collections
features.body: Prepare next-best actions while keeping customer treatment rules visible.

features.title: Treasury & trade
features.body: Coordinate high-value workflows with the approvals that matter built in.

useCases.heading: One persona. Eight regulated workflows.
useCases.subheading: Pick a function and see exactly what Nora reads, how she processes it, what she hands back, and what always stays behind human approval.

inputs.description: Customer / application data and onboarding details from intake channels.
Existing KYC profile, identifiers, and prior KYC context.
Aadhaar / PAN / passport / address proof, photos, signatures, and scanned forms.
Existing customer records in the core banking system.
Mandatory-field and onboarding rules.

capabilities.description: Reads uploaded and scanned IDs, photos, signatures, and forms; detects fields and document completeness.
Branch officer can capture a document or live customer photo where appropriate.
Officer can say "onboard this customer" or explain an exception.
Nora asks for missing information and explains mismatches.
Compares extracted identity data against CKYC/CBS and prepares a proposed customer record — never creates it silently.

workflow.description: Officer asks to onboard a customer
Ingest application and documents
Extract identity fields and retrieve CKYC
Compare records and run completeness checks
Show mismatches and the proposed CBS record
Maker/checker or officer approves customer creation
Create or update the approved CBS record
Onboarding completion and exceptions

selfLearning.learns: Officer-corrected names and addresses, OCR corrections, common document formats, recurring missing fields, and exception routing — improving extraction, fuzzy matching, and confidence thresholds.
selfLearning.neverChanges: KYC policy, identity-verification rules, mandatory fields, or approval authority — never without governance.

inputs.description: Loan application data, borrower profile, requested facility, and current application context.
Credit bureau score, tradelines, repayment history, and exposure context.
Bank statements, income documents, collateral/loan documents, and supporting financial records.
Policy deviation thresholds and approval routing rules.
Current LOS/DMS application state.
Disbursal terms, schedule, and prior entries.

capabilities.description: Reads payslips, statements, collateral/loan documents, and existing sanction formats.
RM or credit officer can ask Nora to "prepare the deviation memo for this case."
Nora explains bureau issues, missing documents, deviations, and proposed terms.
Retrieves bureau/LOS/DMS data and computes policy checks — prepares the file for the authority, never grants credit authority itself.

workflow.description: Process a loan application
Gather application, financials, and bureau data
Normalize figures and identify deviations
Assemble the borrower and deviation dossier
Simulate sanction/disbursal changes
Named credit authority approves, rejects, or edits
Write approved sanction/disbursal and file to DMS
Status, turnaround, and downstream exceptions

selfLearning.learns: Credit-officer edits, recurring document deficiencies, accepted/rejected deviation explanations, bureau-summary corrections, and workflow bottlenecks — improving retrieval, summaries, prioritization, and draft quality.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Lending policy, score cut-offs, LTV/DTI limits, pricing authority, or sanction powers — never autonomously rewritten.

inputs.description: Transaction history and account activity.
Customer KYC / CKYC records and regulatory profile.
Triggered AML scenarios, alert context, and prior analyst notes.
Sanctions and watchlist context.
Regulatory filing rules and thresholds.
CKYC batch upload context.

capabilities.description: Inspects supporting documents, scanned evidence, existing filing forms, and screenshots.
Compliance officer can ask Nora to explain an alert or prepare a filing.
Nora summarizes why an alert fired, asks for evidence, and explains uncertainties.
Collates transactional, KYC, and watchlist context — assembly and first-pass triage, never autonomous regulatory judgment.

workflow.description: Prepare a compliance filing or investigate an alert
Collect customer, transaction, and regulatory evidence
Normalize data and apply fixed compliance rules
Assemble the alert narrative, return, or CKYC batch
Show exactly what's proposed for submission plus unresolved uncertainties
Compliance officer approves or edits
Submit or stage only after approval
Acknowledgements, rejects, filing status, and audit trail

selfLearning.learns: Analyst dispositions of alerts, false-positive reasons, narrative edits, regulator rejections, and missing-evidence patterns — improving triage ranking, evidence retrieval, and draft narratives.
selfLearning.neverChanges: AML scenarios required by policy, sanctions lists, regulatory thresholds, mandatory filing rules, or compliance authority — never self-changed.

inputs.description: Switch transactions file / feed from payment networks and aggregators.
Core banking ledger entries and account balances.
General ledger data, chart of accounts, and journal entries.
Bank statements (PDF/CSV) with debits, credits, and closing balances.
Settlement / clearing files and counterparty statements.
Reconciliation rules, matching logic, tolerances, and accounting policies.

capabilities.description: Reads CSV/PDF statements, screenshots, and legacy-system tables when structured feeds aren't available.
Finance user asks Nora to "explain the unreconciled ₹7,315 item" — Nora explains match logic and evidence.
Useful for quick investigation and approval commands, not mandatory.
Bulk matching across transactions, switch files, CBS, and GL.

workflow.description: Nightly reconciliation trigger
Ingest switch, CBS, GL, and settlement files
Exact and rule-based matching
Similarity/relationship matching on residual items
Explain unmatched or ambiguous transactions
Finance approver clears any posting or adjustment
Post only the approved adjustment
Breaks, ageing, and next-day recurrence

selfLearning.learns: Accepted/rejected match suggestions, recurring merchant/reference patterns, timing differences, and reviewer explanations — improving matching and exception ranking.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Accounting policy, posting authority, materiality limits, or GL-control rules — never self-modified.

inputs.description: Complete customer profile, contact details, and lifecycle interactions.
Account details, balances, limits, and payment history.
Open/closed cases, prior interactions, resolutions, and escalations.
Product terms, charges, eligibility rules, and service policies.
Delinquency status, bucket, overdue details, and risk flags.
Promise-to-pay history, commitments, amounts, and outcomes.

capabilities.description: Strongest modality here — customer or agent speaks naturally; Nora transcribes intent and responds conversationally.
Service conversations, clarifications, draft responses, and human handoff.
Customer can show a statement, letter, screenshot, or document.
Optional for showing documents or screens during assistance.
Pulls account/case/payment context — consequential account changes or settlements stay gated.

workflow.description: Customer or contact arrives
Identify intent and authenticate / resolve context
Retrieve account and case evidence
Prepare an answer or collection proposal
Check policy and customer-impact rules
Human approval where an outbound action, settlement, or account change crosses threshold
Send, update, or log the approved action
Resolution, promise kept/broken, reopen/escalation

selfLearning.learns: Corrected intent classifications, agent edits, successful resolutions, repeated follow-up questions, PTP kept/broken outcomes, and escalation reasons — improving routing, wording, retrieval, and suggested next action.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Consent rules, collection conduct policy, settlement authority, customer-protection requirements, or financial limits — never learned around.

inputs.description: Employee master data, role, department, manager, and location.
Employment status, compensation, attendance, documents, and workflow history.
Identity and access data, roles, groups, entitlements, and SOD rules.
Email accounts, distribution lists, and mailbox permissions.
IT service requests, provisioning tickets, incidents, and change history.
HR policies, role catalogs, access policies, and compliance guidelines.

capabilities.description: Employee or manager asks for onboarding, offboarding, letters, or policy info.
Manager can dictate a joiner/leaver instruction, or an employee asks HR questions by voice.
Parses signed forms, certificates, IDs, or screenshots.
Compares HRMS, directory, email, and access entitlements.

workflow.description: Joiner, leaver, or internal request
Gather employee and role context
Prepare HRMS, email, identity, and access changes
Verify entitlement policy and completeness
Show the exact permission/account diff
Manager and HR/IT approval
Provision or revoke approved resources
Completion, failed tasks, and lingering access

selfLearning.learns: Common role bundles, manager corrections, provisioning failures, frequently missing joiner data, and ticket-resolution paths — improving checklists, routing, and draft correspondence.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Access permissions, segregation-of-duties policy, privileged-role definitions, or approval hierarchy — never self-changed.

inputs.description: Trade deals, instructions, terms, amounts, and counterparty details.
Counterparty confirmations, contract notes, and SWIFT/email confirmations.
Market rates, reference rates, FX/IR curves, and pricing sources.
Dealing blotter entries, positions, trades, and amendments.
Nostro accounts, balances, settlements, and breaks.
Invoices, shipping docs, LC docs, and trade-finance correspondence.
Counterparty and position/risk limits.

capabilities.description: Reads confirmations, invoices, trade documents, and scanned correspondence.
Dealer asks Nora to reconcile a confirmation, prepare a rate upload, or explain a nostro break.
Particularly useful on a trading desk for hands-free requests while the dealer watches the market.
Retrieves deal, blotter, nostro, and rate context — money-moving actions stay behind named/dual approval.

workflow.description: Deal or trade instruction arrives
Collect deal, confirmation, and market/reference data
Extract and compare key terms
Prepare the confirmation, rate, blotter, or nostro action
Verify limits, counterparty, amount, and cut-off state
Named or dual treasury authority
Approved upload, posting, or instruction
Confirmation status, settlement, breaks, and cut-offs

selfLearning.learns: Confirmation discrepancies, document edits, nostro-break resolutions, operational cut-off misses, and recurring counterparty formatting — improving extraction, matching, and operational prioritization.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Dealing limits, FX/risk limits, payment authority, sanctions policy, or dual-control requirements — never self-changed.

inputs.description: Self-help-group meeting data, attendance, collection amounts, and notes.
Group loan accounts, member details, loan status, and instalments.
Daily collections, receipts, overdues, payment mode, and PTP history.
Customer KYC / CKYC identifiers, addresses, photos, and supporting docs.
Scheme enrollment, claim forms, and portal templates.
Claim documents, invoices, photos, and supporting evidence.
Branch/field policies, eligibility rules, and collection norms.

capabilities.description: Strongest differentiator here — field officer can show meeting sheets, forms, claim documents, or physical records from the field.
Extracts handwritten/printed form values and verifies document completeness.
Officer can dictate collection or meeting data in local language instead of typing.
Nora asks "Is this the collection amount for Group 14?" and resolves uncertainties before creating the batch.
Checks customer, group, and scheme records and prepares multi-system updates.

workflow.description: Officer uploads or speaks meeting data
Transcribe/extract forms and collection data
Match members, accounts, and scheme context
Assemble the multi-system batch
Show anomalies, expected values, and every proposed write
Field or branch officer approves the scoped batch
Post the approved batch
Rejected rows, scheme acknowledgements, corrections, and completion

selfLearning.learns: Corrected handwriting/OCR, local-language wording, common field-form structures, rejected batch rows, and scheme-portal errors — improving extraction, mapping, data-quality checks, and clarification prompts.
selfLearning.neverChanges: Product eligibility, credit rules, scheme requirements, collection authority, or branch approval controls — never self-changed.

howItWorks.heading: Agents that act. Bankers stay in control.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: Nora gathers the request, source documents, policy, and context.

steps.title: Simulate
steps.body: She prepares a safe, reviewable version of the workflow first.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: Rules, evidence, and exceptions are checked before anything moves.

steps.title: Approve
steps.body: The right banker sees exactly what will happen and why.

steps.title: Execute
steps.body: Only approved actions run, with a trace ready for audit.

faqs.question: Does Nora replace our core banking systems?
faqs.answer: No. Nora works across the systems, documents, and policies your teams already use. She prepares and coordinates work; your systems remain the system of record.

faqs.question: Who approves an action?
faqs.answer: You define the approval path. Nora makes the planned action, supporting evidence, and exceptions visible to the right banker before it can execute.

faqs.question: How are credentials and permissions handled?
faqs.answer: Access is scoped to the workflow and kept separate from the agent's reasoning. Nora only receives the permissions required for an approved task.

faqs.question: What is available for audit and assurance?
faqs.answer: Each run can preserve the request, evidence, checks, reviewer decisions, and confirmed system action as one traceable record.

contact.heading: Works with your teams, systems, and controls.
contact.body: Nora fits behind the systems, documents, and policies your bank already uses — every approved action leaves a full audit trail. Talk to us about a pilot workflow.
